_doc: Single source of truth for cron metadata. Read by `bin/tq-health` (via jq) and `web/api/staff/estat.py` (via json.load) so adding/removing/renaming a cron is one edit, not three. Keep in sync with `deploy/cron.topquaranta`. Fields: frequency_label = Catalan human label; max_age_hours = stale threshold; skip_concern = consecutive_skips before a still-running instance becomes suspicious; silenced + silenced_reason = swallow watchdog email but still red on dashboard. Optional: description = override for the staff/estat panel one-liner (defaults to the Django Command.help; set this when the cron is a non-Django script or a command-line variant). Test `test_every_cron_has_description` enforces ≥30ch on every entry.

calcular_top_provisional.description: Calcula el top provisional diari amb el senyal acumulat (alias de `calcular_top --provisional`).

actualitzar_playlists_spotify.description: Process A: Spotify playlist sync, cache-only. Reads SpotifyMetadata.spotify_id and pushes to 12 playlists via /items. Never touches /search; that is Process B's job.

actualitzar_playlists_spotify_weekly.description: Process A weekly slice: mirrors the 5 weekly top playlists from TopSetmanal (PPCC + CAT + VAL + BAL + ALT). Same cache-only contract as the daily run.

enriquir_spotify.description: Process B: Spotify enrichment. Search ISRC -> fetch track + artist -> persist SpotifyMetadata. Nightly cadence (moved from hourly 2026-05-24 after repeated Dev-Mode quota bans); --limit 50 covers the ~21 new Cançons/day with ample headroom.

enriquir_spotify_rebuigs.description: Process B backfill: enrich historical rebuig cançons so the per-(deezer_id, spotify_artist_id) ML rejection-ratio feature gains coverage on Deezer-collapsed homonym profiles. Cascade tier 1 (alive shortlist Cançons, ~3 calls/item) is processed first; when exhausted, tier 2 (orphan HR rows whose Canco was deleted by rebutjar_album/rebutjar_artista, ~1 call/ISRC via search_isrc_principal_artist) takes over via --include-orfes (added 2026-05-26 after dry-run + 31-ISRC wet validation: 100% homonyms detected, 1 call/ISRC confirmed, dedupe across multiple HR rows works). Limit chosen by the AIMD controller (state at /var/log/topquaranta/status/enriquir_spotify_rebuigs.controller.json).

descarregar_portades.description: Self-hosted cover pipeline (Fase 1, 2026-05-30): downloads Deezer covers (album.imatge_url, canco.album.imatge_url, artista.imatge_url) and transcodes each to webp/avif/jpg variants at 250+500 px under PORTADES_ROOT (/var/topquaranta/portades/<entitat>/<deezer_id>-<mida>.<format>). State is the filesystem (no DB column); --force re-downloads, otherwise the 500.webp sentinel skips already-present covers. Caps at 200 entities/run, ~0.4s throttle. Caddy serving + SPA consumption are later phases. See docs/architecture/portades.md.

tq-restore-test.description: Smoke-test mensual: restaura el darrer dump dins una BD temporal i verifica les fila-counts. No Django command (script bash a `/home/topquaranta/bin/`).

tq-backup.description: Còpia de seguretat diària de PostgreSQL amb retenció escalonada (daily 7d / weekly 4w / monthly 12m). Script bash a `/home/topquaranta/bin/`, corre com a usuari postgres. Caçat 2026-06-07: el backup corria fora del contracte tq-run i no el vigilava res.

tq-recover.description: Escombrada de recuperació: detecta runs de cron diaris perduts o fallits i els rellança via tq-run, amb un tope diari per comanda. Script bash a `/home/topquaranta/bin/`. Caçat 2026-06-07: la mateixa xarxa de recuperació no estava monitorada.

publicar_canal_mastodon.description: Distribució multicanal al canal Mastodon (variant `publicar_canal --channel mastodon`). Mateix calendari que publicar_social, 10 min després de la publicació d'Instagram.

publicar_canal_bluesky.description: Distribució multicanal al canal Bluesky (variant `publicar_canal --channel bluesky`). Mateix calendari que publicar_social, 20 min després de la publicació d'Instagram.

publicar_canal_telegram.description: Distribució multicanal al canal Telegram (variant `publicar_canal --channel telegram`). Mateix calendari que publicar_social, 25 min després; envia el carrusel sencer.

publicar_canal_newsletter.description: Distribució multicanal del top global per email (variant `publicar_canal --channel newsletter --tipus top_ppcc`). Només dissabte per no saturar la llista de subscriptors.
